items.title: ‘A more expensive EU is not a better EU’: Austria's Minister for Europe, Claudia Bauer
items.summary: This week's programme hosted Claudia Bauer, Austria’s Federal Minister for Europe, Integration and Family while she was in Paris for the recent G7 meeting. She offered her thoughts on the diplomatic moves surrounding Ukraine, transatlantic relations, EU enlargement and a headscarf ban in Austrian schools that has caused disquiet. We also talked about the thorny negotiations involved in the EU’s next long-term budget: the Multiannual Financial Framework.

items.title: Trump leaves Shenzhen empty-handed
items.summary: TEHRAN — Donald Trump flew to Shenzhen promising a historic meeting with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin. He flew home Thursday with a group photograph and a declaration that commits nobody to anything. The three men sat at a round wooden table in a lakeside villa for about 80 minutes, then issued a four-point statement. Nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought, it said.

ai.sum: Trump met Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen and the three issued a four-point statement on nuclear war without concrete commitments.
